import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0078 {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : ℕ → M) :
  ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico a (b + 1), f k = (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f k) * f b := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0078 {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (f : ℕ → M) :
  ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico a (b + 1), f k = (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f k) * f b :=
by
  rw [Finset.prod_Ico_succ_top hab f]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0078 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0078 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0078

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0078
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0078
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
